column1: # Rulings on this pair, kept by hand. refuse with both sides: that shape is never a link, whatever proposes it (source: only from that source). refuse with one side and a source: those words leave that source's rows. accept: the shape is pinned and wins every competition.

column6: Ὀμμαίους / זּוּזִ֖ים: Claude, 2026-10-14: the Septuagint renders the Zuzim 'strong nations'; Ὀμμαίους is the Emim at position 28.
Σαυῇ / הָ֑ם: Claude, 2026-10-14: Σαυῇ is Shaveh at position 30; the Septuagint reads 'in Ham' as 'with them'.
οἰκονόμοις / מָרְדֳּכַ֣י: Claude, 2026-11-01: οἰκονόμοις is the stewards the king commanded; Mordecai is not in the Greek's verse.
